status: draft — issue #509, epic #507; no device reads this file yet. Format: docs/records/design-reviews/io-contract-modules.md > 5.
goal: The acceptance criteria the cycle works to: the analysis report's criteria with every settled acceptance-criterion decision applied (Q5).

decisions.note: Each entry carries what a script needs to apply it (Q5): the AC id, the operation and, for an operation that writes text, the new text. Today's grammar has no text field (docs/decision-ledger.md > Acceptance-criterion decisions); sub-issue 3 adds it.

rules.rule: Each decision is applied once, in ledger order: excluded removes the criterion, revised replaces its text, split replaces it by the criteria Into names, added appends one. A decision naming an AC id that is not present at its turn is refused.
